newsitem.title: USA: Resource stake raised by Kramer Spellman.
newsitem.headline: Resource stake raised by Kramer Spellman.

text.p: A group led by Kramer Spellman L.P said Wednesday it raised its stake in Resource America Inc to 478,500 common shares or 13.47 percent from 11.31 percent held on Jan 16.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 41,000 additional common shares between Feb 14 and March 4 at $24.125 to $24.50 per share.
The group holds the stake in the Philadelphia, Pa., company for investment.
Resoure is engaged in the acquisition and resolution of commercial real estate loans, commercial equipment leasing and energy operations including gas and oil production.
